title: Warm Smoky Russian Cauliflower Pilaf
description: A smoky and crisp Russian-inspired dish featuring roasted cauliflower, this pilaf is a low-glycemic friendly option for a satisfying meal. It combines the flavors of tadka with the comfort of a warm pilaf.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
Toss the cauliflower florets with 1 tablespoon of ghee, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper on a baking sheet, and roast for 20 minutes.
In a large skillet, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of ghee over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet, stirring to combine with the onion and garlic mixture.
Add the roasted cauliflower and chicken broth to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Cook for an additional 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until the liquid has been absorbed and the pilaf is heated through.
Serve the pilaf warm, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
